content: vk-bootstrap's PhysicalDeviceSelector defaults to PreferredDeviceType::discrete, with allow_any_gpu_device_type() defaulting to true (falls back to any suitable device, including integrated, if no discrete GPU qualifies). It returns the first device fully satisfying selection criteria, or the first partially-satisfying device if none fully qualify -- it does not by itself tie-break multiple discrete GPUs by VRAM heap size.
